findings.description: The condition uses all(...) where the docstring and title say the section is shown if at least one argument is documented. It should be any(...). With all(), a single undocumented argument suppresses the whole section.
findings.rationale: Trigger: a command with two arguments where only one has help. all() returns False, so the "Positional arguments" section is omitted and the documented argument disappears from --help. Previously that argument was listed. Also, with no arguments at all, all([]) is True, so an empty "Positional arguments" section header is emitted for every command without arguments.
